column1: # Gateway capabilities use the canonical resource form `tool:<name>`
# matching the tool names in infra/config/mcp_allowlist.toml.
# Admin role: unrestricted (mirrors the Cedar jarvis_admin permit)
# OpenCode agent role - mirrors the `opencode` grants in mcp_allowlist.toml
# (the allowlist still has to grant each tool to the opencode principal)
# System role: internal operations (mirrors the Cedar jarvis_system permit)
# The kill switch is enforced out-of-band by the policy engine (KillSwitch);
# an allow-only Casbin model cannot express "deny all".
